Job Description
Posted Thursday, July 30, 2026 at 7:00 AM

HOK is a collective of future-forward thinkers and designers who are driven to face the critical challenges of our time. We are dedicated to improving people's lives, serving our clients and healing the planet. Together, we cultivate a culture of design excellence at the confluence of art and science, blending the power of creative expression with a clear sense of purpose.

In partnership with the Project Architect and Project Designer, accountable for project financial performance and team communication. Manages one or more projects during all phases of a project until completion. Directs employees and consultants at all levels to ensure that proper steps and procedures are taken and that work is completed as planned, budgeted, scheduled and in conformance with the design intent.

Leadership

Fosters and maintains a collaborative professional working relationship with the Project Leadership Team.
Participates on and/or leads multiple project teams as Project Manager.
Assists senior management in developing and validating project scope and fee, budget, and scope of services during the marketing and contract development process.
Assists in preparing project presentations. May participate and/or lead client presentations.
Consistently provides complete and timely communication of project information to and from clients and project team. Responsible for managing project using the Deltek Project Management system; completes work plans in Deltek; including identification of project team members, budget, consultants, schedule for completion, fees and costs as well as project change notices or other actions taking place on the assigned project.
Assists senior management in the preparation and execution of consultant contracts.
Assists with negotiating fees and contracts.
Ensures that budgets have been developed to provide for Quality Management Program through the life of the Project.
Incorporates Integrated Sustainable Design solutions into projects.
Takes personal responsibility for fostering a green workplace through sustainable work practices.
Fosters a commitment to external and internal client service.

Management

Works with Project Architect to avoid or eliminate conflicts in schedule due to the changes in various projects.
Plans, organizes and manages project. Provides on-going communication through team meetings/minutes/up-date memos to project team.
Communicates with consultants, contractors, sub-consultants and other disciplines to ensure effective communication.
Monitors construction administration during the construction phase
Develops and maintains positive relationships with clients and consultants.

Client Interface

Responsible for maintaining client relationships throughout project. Keeps client apprised of project progress on regular basis. Initiates and maintains contact with other key project individuals for clarification, coordination and negotiation of critical issues.
Consults with client to determine function and spatial requirements and prepares information regarding design, specifications, materials, color, equipment, estimated costs, and construction time. Plans layouts of projects and integrates engineering elements into unified design for client review and approval.

Business Development

Participates in developing annual business plan for the business unit.
Identifies new business opportunities while developing current client relationships. Listens for and seek out new projects which may exist or are being formulated.
Participates in selected marketing and business development opportunities.
Assists in development of fee proposals for marketing proposals.

Staff Development

Provides leadership including professional development coaching and mentoring staff.
Defines staff requirements for projects as needed or directed. Makes recommendations to senior management for staff promotions/terminations for project team and Architecture discipline. May participate in interviews and recruiting of professional staff.

Bachelor’s degree in architecture or equivalent in education or experience required. Master’s degree preferred.
5 years’ experience in architectural practice with management experience in all phases of projects through post-occupancy.
Licensed Architect with current registration in your region preferred, if licensure is offered in your region.

Travel may be required.
Overtime may be required.
The job duties and requirements that this document describes may be altered or supplemented at any time at the sole discretion of HOK.

Many of our roles require the use of specific software. Please refer to the Required and Preferred Software & Skills for details.

HOK invests in its people and communities, supporting both personal and professional growth through every stage of life. At HOK you’ll have a hybrid work environment, 10 paid holidays (including 2 floating holidays) and a minimum of 4 weeks of paid time off with a cash out option.

HOK offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, free mental wellness resources, life and AD&D coverage and short and long-term disability benefits. HOK supports your growing family by offering 4 weeks of paid parental leave and fertility coverage.

HOK helps to fund your future financial needs with matching contributions to our 401(K) plan which includes a well-rounded investment menu as well as free guidance on retirement planning.

Wherever you are in your career, HOK provides opportunities to learn, develop and utilize your skills. Continued learning is promoted through financial support and study prep for licensure exams, CEU credit opportunities, mentorship programs, and paid professional memberships. To learn more about designing your career with HOK, explore our current job openings.

HOK is an EOE, including disability/vets.

Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, education and location. The reasonably expected salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000. Other compensation may include a discretionary bonus.

We thrive on multi-disciplinary engagement, practicing at the intersection of architecture, interiors, and urban design. As a Project Manager, you will…

Set direction, in collaboration with each project’s Partner/Principal-in-Charge, Design Partner, Senior Designer, and Project Architect, for the execution of project goals and objectives with project team and client, define of scope, identify items for investigation, and develop novel concepts and methods.
Independently develop project proposals and contracts, define and manage work plans, organize and supervise design teams, participate in presentations and interviews and find creative solutions to project challenges.
Serve as the primary client liaison.
Cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with clients while managing projects both large and small.
Proactively manage teams from concept design through construction and have a deep understanding of building, zoning, energy codes, ADA, construction standards, and other regulatory requirements.
Optimize every team member’s opportunity for growth and professional development.
Display a passion for design excellence and exceptional project delivery while pursuing the highest value possible for our clients.

Seek engagement and collaboration at all levels, including the internal and external design team, clients and contractors.

Fluidly move between project management tasks, production, and marketing as needed, dependent on office priorities.

Comfortable and effective in a leadership capacity to bring exceptional creativity and excellent technical knowledge to the delivery of high quality and complex healthcare projects.
Excellent communication skills enabling you to establish and maintain project criteria, communicate them to project teams, and manage projects with confidence and ease while ensuring design intention is maintained throughout all project phases.

Role: Senior Program Manager, Client Experience

Location: New York City (hybrid)

Type: Full-Time

Apply here

At Athletics, Client Experience is intentionally designed to build trust and drive outcomes for both our clients and the agency. We believe great creative work thrives when clarity, momentum, and thoughtful structure are considered.

We’re seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead complex branding and strategic initiatives for forward-thinking organizations. This role sits at the intersection of strategic account partnership and program delivery. You are responsible for translating brand and digital engagements into structured, scalable programs while shaping client relationships that deepen over time. You protect creative excellence by building the systems, alignment, and foresight that allow it to thrive.

This role is posted at the Senior Program Manager level. Depending on experience and demonstrated scope of ownership, we may consider candidates at the Program Manager level, with corresponding adjustments to title and compensation.

You will serve as the architect of the engagement. You bring order to ambiguity, stay calm in complexity, align stakeholders around clear outcomes, and anticipate friction before it slows momentum. You operate as both a strategic thought partner to clients and a delivery leader internally, ensuring programs are creatively ambitious, commercially sound, and operationally rigorous.

Senior Program Managers are not task managers. They are stewards of long-term partnerships, accountable for client success, project clarity, profitability, and identifying areas for program growth.

Program Leadership
Lead large, multi-disciplinary branding and digital projects. Define program architecture: scope, phasing, success metrics, and stakeholder alignment.
Elevate conversations beyond deliverables, helping clients clarify priorities, navigate tradeoffs, and make confident decisions.
Client Engagement & Partnership Development
Serve as a primary point of contact and trusted advisor. Design a Client Experience that is proactive, transparent, and insight-driven (not reactive or transactional).
Identify and shape natural growth opportunities grounded in client need and program evolution.
Delivery Excellence & Risk Management
Own end-to-end execution across scope, timeline, budget, and quality. Proactively identify risks, surface tensions early, and propose solutions before issues escalate.
Ensure work is delivered to brief, aligned to strategic intent, and executed with operational discipline.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment
Partner closely with Strategy, Creative, Technology, and the Resourcing Director to assemble and support the right teams. Create clarity in roles, expectations, and decision-making authority.
Financial Accountability
Track and report on financial health across engagements. Forecast resource needs, manage profitability, and identify efficiencies across your programs.
Process Improvement
Help advance internal tools and systems to improve clarity, collaboration, and delivery. Bring a continuous improvement mindset to the team.
Mentorship & Leadership
Provide thoughtful guidance and leadership to junior team members, supporting growth while upholding standards of excellence. Model calm, decisive leadership in high-pressure moments.

Clients seek your perspective early, not just your updates.
Programs consistently meet or exceed project health expectations.
Teams describe your program plans as clear, decisive, and enabling.
You proactively identify risks (and potential solutions) before they become client-facing challenges.
Engagements evolve into long-term partnerships (when feasible).

5+ years of experience managing branding programs in a creative agency or consultancy environment.
Proven success leading complex, high-stakes projects from pitch through launch.
Fluency in brand strategy, visual identity, and digital product design/development processes.
Strong business acumen: able to forecast, scope, budget, and communicate with clarity and confidence.
Empathy and diplomacy: able to manage client relationships and internal dynamics with nuance. You’re calm under pressure and bring a positive mindset
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can lead a room or finesse a slide deck with ease.
Experience working and experimenting with both traditional project management best practice tools like Notion, Smartsheet, and similar, alongside rapidly evolving AI platforms
Bachelor’s degree required; project management certifications and/or advanced degrees are a plus.

Athletics is a brand innovation studio based in NYC, working with organizations at the forefront of culture, technology, and design. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where creativity thrives and careers grow.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of creative delivery at a growing studio—balancing structure with ambition, and process with possibility.

Athletics operates in a hybrid model, with employees working in-person from our studio in Brooklyn, NY a minimum of 2 days per week. Our model has flexibility for our team built-in, including fully remote options during the summer, plus remote work week allowances in the fall, winter, and spring. Candidates should be based in proximity to NYC and able to work in-person in accordance with our policy.

Base salary $90-120K, depending on experience and skillset. Benefits for full-time employees include participation in a value-sharing plan with bonus payouts; health insurance; 401k with guaranteed employee contribution; life insurance; generous paid time off; professional development budget; weekly team meals and in-office snacks; free Citibike memberships; + additional health and wellness perks.

Would you like to lead ambitious projects, take on responsibility, and work with a team to develop compelling solutions? Do you have experience in project management, the ability to keep track of the big picture, and a keen eye for quality? If so, we look forward to getting to know you.

C.F. Møller Architects is one of Scandinavia’s leading architectural firms and has been synonymous with award-winning architecture in the Nordic countries and around the world for over 100 years. Our work combines experience, innovation, and Nordic values to create architectural quality that meets both sustainable and aesthetic standards. In this way, we create solutions with lasting value—for clients, users, and society.

C.F. Møller Architects has also had a presence in Berlin for the past seven years. In our office, located on a bright top floor in Schöneberg between Gleisdreieckpark and the Neue Nationalgalerie, an international team of over 35 architects works on a wide variety of projects.

For our Berlin office, we are currently seeking experienced architects to lead challenging projects in Germany, particularly in the areas of office, administrative, cultural, research, and education buildings. You will become part of the multidisciplinary team at C.F. Møller Architects, where a passion for design, holistic thinking, and the commitment to turning creative ideas into compelling solutions shape our daily work.

You are an architect with extensive experience in project management and are familiar with the diverse requirements of complex construction projects—from conception through planning to completion. You are skilled at confidently integrating design, technical, economic, and organizational aspects.

You possess a strong architectural and technical understanding that enables you to confidently assess the quality of plans and develop compelling solutions to both design and structural challenges. Managing budgets, deadlines, and processes is just as much a part of your role as maintaining close coordination with senior management.

Your leadership skills are based on experience leading teams and projects, as well as on an empathetic, engaging, and clear communication style. When interacting with colleagues, clients, and specialist planners, you come across as confident, professional, and solution-oriented.

You bring five to seven years’ experience in project management in German-speaking countries, as well as in-depth knowledge of all project phases.

You combine a commitment to quality down to the last detail with a clear view of the bigger picture, and you stand out for your dedication, attention to detail, openness, team spirit and forward-thinking approach. Excellent communication skills and a good command of German and English are essential.

Proficiency in Revit/BIM, MS Office and Adobe CS rounds off your profile.

We offer you a permanent, full-time position with a salary commensurate with your experience and performance, as well as the opportunity to work independently and take on responsibility. As part of an international team of around 300 colleagues across eight locations, you will be introduced to the in-house standards of C.F. Møller Architects.

Your place of work is Berlin. In addition, you will occasionally travel to the sites of our construction projects and to our headquarters in Denmark.

We support your professional and personal development through internal seminars and regular participation in external training programs. You can expect a dedicated team characterized by open communication, mutual respect, and strong camaraderie.

Practical Information
Please submit your complete application materials in German or English via our career portal.

Your application should include a compelling portfolio, a cover letter, and a resume in table format specifying your available start date and salary expectations, as a PDF file no longer than 50 pages or 20 MB.

Description

The Senior Project Manager / Campus Planner is a firmwide planning leader responsible for managing complex campus and institutional planning projects while also providing hands-on planning expertise in Space Planning/Programming and Urban/Campus Design.

This role operates across functions and departments to uphold a culture of design excellence, strengthen client relationships, and ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and at a consistently high standard.

The position requires a service-focused mindset, strong leadership and mentoring abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple project teams and deliverables simultaneously with only intermittent oversight.

Project Leadership & Delivery
Lead planning efforts from programming and concept through documentation and client presentations, driving high-quality outcomes with minimal direction.
Manage multiple projects concurrently, including large, complex projects with varied scope, stakeholders, and consultant teams.

Lead quality oversight for planning deliverables, including narratives, diagrams, graphics, and presentation materials.

Internal Coordination
Organize planning efforts across teams and departments, supporting a firm culture of design excellence.
Coordinate internal resources and planning support, helping teams stay aligned on priorities and deadlines.
Partner with design leadership to drive great planning outcomes and cohesive presentations.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
Provide motivation, mentorship, and design leadership to planning staff through all phases of work.
Mentor planning and architectural staff, helping build technical proficiency and leadership skills.
Support team development through coaching, feedback, and modeling best practices for planning process and communication.

Operate with a service-focused approach while maintaining accountability to client requirements, expectations, and budget.
Support scope clarity and change management to protect schedule and profitability.
Business Development & Marketing
Actively participate in proposal development to win new work (writing, coordination, schedules, resumes, and work plans).
Attend interviews and contribute to interview strategy and presentation quality.
Engage in both internal and external business development efforts, supporting relationship building and opportunity cultivation.

Urban/Campus Design: Lead large-scale campus and district planning, policy frameworks, infrastructure strategy, and cross-disciplinary coordination.

Data Analysis: Apply advanced data modeling, scenario planning, and predictive analytics to inform planning direction and decision-making.

Company Description

At KPFF Consulting Engineers, we are more than just an engineering design firm. For 65 years, we have dedicated ourselves to innovative, sustainable engineering that shapes the built environment and tackles complex infrastructure challenges. Our team culture emphasizes balance, growth, and well-being, supporting each member’s professional journey with flexibility, generous benefits, and a collaborative approach to work-life integration.

With nearly 1,500 professionals across 36 offices nationwide, KPFF’s decentralized structure allows each office the flexibility to pursue projects aligned with their regional strengths. Learn more at www.kpff.com.

Job Description

We’re hiring a Structural Project Manager to support and grow our Austin, Texas team. This senior-level role is ideal for a licensed structural engineer ready to lead complex building design projects, deepen client relationships, and contribute to the continued expansion of KPFF’s presence across Central Texas and surrounding markets.

At KPFF, you’ll manage vertical structure projects from concept through construction administration, mentor a talented group of engineers, and actively support business development initiatives. You’ll collaborate closely with architects, developers, owners, and contractors to deliver high-quality structural designs for commercial, residential, mixed-use, education, healthcare, and institutional projects.

As you grow with us, you’ll also have opportunities to pursue pathways to ownership, reflecting KPFF’s commitment to recognizing leadership, technical excellence, and long-term contributions.

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of being in the Austin office three days per week for collaboration, mentoring, and client meetings. While we support flexible work arrangements, this role is not fully remote. In-person presence is especially important for leadership engagement, technical mentorship, and client interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

Serve as the primary technical and client-facing lead on structural projects, ensuring strong relationships and successful delivery.
Lead project execution from schematic design through construction administration, managing schedules, budgets, quality standards, and team performance.
Oversee and review structural analysis and design for steel, concrete, wood, and masonry building systems.
Direct preparation of construction documents including calculations, drawings, specifications, and design narratives.
Coordinate closely with architects, MEP consultants, contractors, fabricators, and specialty structural reviewers.
Collaborate with teams in both Austin and San Diego, supporting projects across markets as part of our integrated reporting center structure.
Navigate Texas jurisdictional approval processes and building code compliance, including:
International Building Code (IBC) and local amendments
City of Austin Development Services Department
Special inspections and threshold building coordination
Provide construction-phase support including shop drawing review, RFIs, site observations, and field coordination.
Support business development efforts including proposals, interviews, and cultivating relationships with local clients and design partners.
Mentor and develop engineers and designers, fostering both technical excellence and leadership growth.
Represent KPFF in industry organizations and local professional groups, contributing to the visibility and reputation of the Austin team.

Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering with structural emphasis (Master’s preferred).
PE license required.
8+ years of structural engineering experience, primarily focused on building design.
Proven experience managing multi-discipline building projects and coordinating consultant teams.
Strong working knowledge of steel, concrete, wood, and masonry design.
Experience applying national codes and standards including IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, NDS, and TMS specifications.
Proficiency with structural analysis and design tools such as ETABS, RAM, RISA, SAFE, and project coordination platforms, with working familiarity drafting tools used by production teams.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience mentoring staff engineers.
Effective communicator with strong organizational and client-facing skills.
Ability to work in the Austin office at least three days per week under the hybrid work model.
Additional Information

Physical Demands

Work is primarily performed in a standard office setting with long periods of work at a computer.
Occasional lifting of items up to 15 pounds.
Visits to construction sites may involve walking, standing, climbing stairs or ladders, navigating uneven surfaces, or exposure to weather.
Local travel may be required for project meetings, observations, or client visits.

The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000 with candidates who have at least 8 years of experience, proven project management skills, and business development success. Final compensation will also consider education, licensure, and overall skills. We also provide performance-based bonuses to recognize outstanding contributions.

For those who demonstrate long-term impact and leadership, KPFF offers pathways to ownership, creating opportunities to directly share in the firm’s growth and success. During the interview process, we’ll review the full compensation package and answer any questions you may have.

At KPFF, your career growth and well-being matter. We offer a supportive environment that values autonomy, innovation, and teamwork. Here, your contributions are celebrated, your ideas are welcomed, and your career has room to grow.

Mentorship & Growth: Through KPFF’s Forefront Education Program, you’ll have access to continuous learning, leadership development, and opportunities to advance your career while helping others do the same.
Strong Connections: We believe in trust, collaboration, and long-term relationships, both with our clients and within our teams. Open communication and teamwork are at the heart of how we operate.
Supportive Culture: Your well-being matters. We encourage balance, provide resources for a healthy lifestyle, and create opportunities to connect through social activities and community events.

We’re proud to offer flexible and competitive benefits, including:

Medical Plan Options: PPO or HDHP with HSA, covering preventive care and prescriptions.
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA): Tax-advantaged accounts for healthcare and dependent care.
Dental & Vision: Full preventive care plus coverage for major services.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Free, confidential support for personal, family, and work challenges.
Life & AD&D Insurance: Company-provided life insurance equal to one year’s salary.
401(k) Retirement Plan: KPFF contributes 3% of salary, with no match required.
Disability Insurance: Short- and long-term coverage at 60% income, fully covered by KPFF.

Structural Project Manager - Structures Practice
Los Angeles, CA
Full Time
Los Angeles Office
Experienced

You want to run projects. Not just work on them - actually own them, lead the team, build the client relationship, and put your name on the outcome.

Our Structures Practice is looking for a Structural Engineer with the technical chops and the people skills to do exactly that. If you've spent the last few years building your craft and you're ready to step into a project leadership role across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use work - let's talk.

Who We Are

Holmes US is an international structural engineering firm with offices up and down the West Coast and a home base that goes back over 65 years to New Zealand. We're part of the Holmes Group - 500+ people worldwide - which means you get the resources and technical depth of a global firm alongside the culture and relationships of a West Coast practice where people actually know each other.

Our Structures Practice takes on the kind of work that shapes how people experience their city: university buildings, multi-family housing, civic projects, commercial developments, and seismic retrofits of the buildings already standing. The variety is intentional - it keeps the work interesting and the skill set broad.

What You'll Actually Do

Lead structural engineering projects from concept through construction administration across commercial, multi-family, education, civic, or mixed-use building types
Own client relationships - managing scope, schedule, budget, and expectations with clarity and consistency
Develop technically rigorous structural solutions across concrete, steel, wood, and masonry
Direct, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and designers
Drive quality control and technical reviews on your projects
Contribute to business development through strong client relationships and repeat work
Collaborate across Holmes practice areas - and, when a project calls for it, across our international offices
4-8+ years of structural engineering experience in a consultancy setting

s.h: PE license required; SE license preferred or in active pursuit
s.t:
B.S. or M.S. in Civil / Structural Engineering
Seismic design experience - this is core to our practice, not a bonus
Demonstrated ability to manage projects and lead or mentor a team
Strong communication skills - you're as comfortable presenting to a client as you are reviewing calcs
Proficiency in ETABS, SAP2000, or RISA

Depending on your experience, this role will be placed at our Project Engineer or Senior Engineer level. What we're looking for in either case is someone ready to lead projects, not just contribute to them.

Why Holmes?

The breadth of our portfolio is a genuine advantage for your career. You're not going to spend five years on the same building type. You'll tackle seismic retrofits, new high-rises, school campuses, and mixed-use developments - often in the same year. That variety means you build a skill set that holds up over a long career.

We invest in our people seriously. Holmes University is our internal learning platform, giving you access to technical training and leadership development throughout your career. Senior engineers and principals here are genuinely available - mentorship isn't a line item in a brochure, it's how we actually operate. And when you need it, you have access to the technical depth of the Holmes network across New Zealand and Australia.

We also believe you follow your interests. There's a clear path to leadership and ownership at Holmes - and we'll be straight with you about what it looks like from where you're standing.

Work-Life Balance, and We Mean It

Our hybrid model is three days in the office - the rest is yours. We offer biannual profit share so you participate in the success you help create. And we've worked hard to build a culture where overtime is the exception, not the expectation. You'll do better work when you're not running on empty, and we structure the practice accordingly.

We’re in the business of helping millions of people make better decisions. We need some help too…

Applied Information Group is an award-winning, multi-disciplinary design consultancy. We help businesses and public agencies improve the experience and understanding of spaces for their customers and citizens.

We work internationally for blue chip clients providing a unique set of skills specialising in planning and designing information systems for navigating and enjoying buildings, campuses, transit networks and cities. From our offices in London, San Francisco, Vancouver and Seoul, we design signs, maps, screens and digital applications and produce everything needed from brand guidelines to industrial design specifications, and governance strategies to smartphone apps.

‍

Working at Applied means working in a fast-paced environment where you will get to be involved with project management on a variety of projects. You will be responsible for high quality project management of projects ensuring delivery is on time and on budget, while managing client relationships, growing your accounts and reporting of financial and commercial opportunities to the wider business.

‍

Key Tasks

· To ensure the smooth running and delivery of client projects / streams as assigned to you by the business.

· Develop strong client relationships so that they receive a high quality experience and service from the team

· Work with the project team to ensure budget and timeline targets are met for projects.

· Build and develop scope opportunities with your client contacts

· Financial analysis and reporting of your accounts and projects

· Contribute to the wider objectives of the business through seeking continuous improvement around project and account management processes

‍

· Manage small to medium sized accounts, along with streams of work within larger multi-faceted client accounts

· Own, develop and grow strong client relationship, from successful onboarding to project completion

· Organise and maintain project dashboards

· Lead internal check-ins with the project lead to review resource needs and forecast billings

· Upon identification of an opportunity, work to develop a clearly defined scope, to be signed off by your client contact. This may require managing the project lead, commercial director, and other team members to ensure the proposal is written on time.

· Assist the Business Development team in the development of high-quality, competitive proposals and presentations for new commercial opportunities

· With the wider Project team, contribute to project roadmap planning and lead coordination where necessary

· Reporting to the Commercial Director, forecast revenue and identify any additional commercial opportunities as needed

· Lead the creation of account plans / account dashboard

· Ensure any subcontractor requirements are coordinated and costed within the project budget

· Inform milestones/deadlines for resourcing needs

· Develop and deliver Performance reports to the Commercial team

· Ensure invoices are accurately submitted and work with finance team on any payment issues with your accounts

‍

Other roles within Applied

· Support the induction of new staff

· Ensure the company's social and environmental improvements are made, as part of our B Corp commitments

· Represent the company with professionalism and credibility.

The above is a general description of duties, the post holder will be expected to perform other duties as necessary and appropriate to ensure the effective running of the business and its services.

‍

We will select applicants based on merit including relevant experience, skills, and interest in the role.

We are a company that is fully committed to advancing people and society and looking after the planet. Applied is B Corp certified. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or age.

‍

· Ability to confidently navigate unexpected / sudden requests and unforeseen detours

As part of our Architecture practice at HDR, you’ll contribute to the design and delivery of spaces and experiences that advance community well-being around the world.

From healing environments and learning spaces to research labs and civic landmarks and infrastructure, your work will directly influence how individuals experience the world around them. We bring together architects, planners, designers, and technical experts to solve complex design challenges with creativity, curiosity, and collaboration.

s.h: In the role of Senior Project Manager, we'll count on you to

What Do We Do?
Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern ecommerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it bites.
We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the most actionable AI in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby 2 doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.
The result: more than 65,000 brands like Pressed Juicery, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

We’re looking for an Implementation Manager, Enterprise to lead the onboarding journey for Triple Whale ’s largest and most complex customers. The role is equal parts consultative and coordinative. You’ll sit with sophisticated marketing and analytics teams to understand what they are actually trying to accomplish, then drive the people, sequencing, and detail that turn it into a live, adopted account — from contract signature through full go-live.
It is also hands-on and technical. Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis
### Unser Angebot ###
* Eine vielseitige und sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem motivierten Team
* Gelebte flache Hierarchien und flexible Home-Office-Regelungen
* Spannende Einblicke in die vielseitigen Tätigkeiten unserer Einheiten
* Ein Arbeitsort direkt am Hauptbahnhof
* Die Stelle ist in Lohnklasse 20 eingereiht (Informationen zum Lohnsystem).

## Projektleitung Pionierprojekt - Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung ##
### 30% vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase vom 1. Januar bis 31. Dezember 2027. ###
Du möchtest Kindern in hoch belasteten Lebenslagen, für die es bisher kaum passende Wohnformen gibt, einen sicheren Lebensort ermöglichen?
Wirke mit am Aufbau eines neuen, familiären und traumapädagogischen Angebots im Kanton Luzern!
Ausgangslage
Die Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung Luzern und Subito Kriseninterventionen entwickeln im Auftrag des Kantons Luzern ein neues traumapädagogisches, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot.

Das Angebot richtet sich an Kinder, Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene bis maximal 25 Jahre mit stark belastenden Bindungs- und Beziehungserfahrungen sowie herausfordernden Verhaltensweisen, für die bestehende stationäre Wohnformen oder Pflegeverhältnisse nicht ausreichend tragfähig sind.

Ziel ist es, dass die Kinder und Jugendlichen im Zuhause eines Menschen mit Ausbildung im Sozialbereich leben, der diese Aufgabe als Haupterwerb übernimmt und zusätzliche Unterstützung von weiteren Menschen aus dem eigenen sowie professionellen Umfeld erhält.
Die erste Projektphase vom 1. Januar 2027 bis 31. Dezember 2027 dient dazu, die fachlichen und organisatorischen Grundlagen sorgfältig zu entwickeln und die Umsetzung ab 2028 vorzubereiten. Dafür suchen wir eine initiative, verbindende und fachlich starke Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, Neues aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und traumapädagogisches Wissen wirksam in die Praxis zu übersetzen.
### Funktion ###
Projektleitung Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung
### Pensum ###
30 %
### Dauer ###
Vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2027. Es besteht die Option einer Verlängerung bei Abschluss der ersten Projektphase.
### Projektziel ###
Aufbau des neuen Angebots: Erarbeitung von Konzept und Kooperationsgrundlagen, Rekrutierung und Anstellung von Betreuungspersonen, allgemeine Vorbereitung der Leistungserbringung, Zusammenarbeit mit externen Anspruchsgruppen aufbauen
### Arbeitsfeld ###
Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Traumapädagogik, Pflegekinderwesen, stationäre Intensivbetreuung im familiären Umfeld
Deine Aufgabe
In der Rolle Projektleitung gestaltest du die Aufbauarbeit eines innovativen Angebots mit hoher fachlicher und gesellschaftlicher Bedeutung. Du entwickelst tragfähige Grundlagen, steuerst den Projektprozess, vernetzt zentrale Partnerinnen und Partner und bringst traumapädagogische Expertise so ein, dass ab 2028 ein wirksames, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot starten kann.
Deine Hauptaufgaben konkret
* Aufbau der Projektorganisation mit den beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung und Subito Kriseninterventionen und weiteren relevanten Anspruchsgruppen inkl. Leitung eines Projektteams
* Entwicklung des Konzepts für die traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung unter punktuellem Einbezug externer traumapädagogischer Expertise und in Zusammenarbeit mit den zukünftigen Betreuungspersonen
* Definition der Aufnahme- und Ausschlusskriterien sowie der konkreten Leistungsinhalte
* Erarbeitung einer tragfähigen Lösung für die Tagesstruktur, falls vorübergehend kein Schulplatz vorhanden ist
* Aufbau der Zusammenarbeit mit der Luzerner Psychiatrie und Erarbeitung einer Kooperationsvereinbarung
* Ausarbeitung der Stellenbeschriebe und Rekrutierung des künftigen Betreuungspersonals, gewünscht ist eine frühzeitige Einbindung der hauptbetreuenden Person in die Konzeptentwicklung
* Vorbereitung der Arbeitsverträge und weiterer Anstellungsunterlagen für Betreuungspersonen unter Einbezug juristischer Expertise
* Aufgleisung der fachlichen Unterstützung für die Betreuungspersonen, insbesondere Gruppensupervision
* Bekanntmachung des Projekts bei wichtigen zuweisenden Stellen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Leitungen der beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen
* Entwicklung von Instrumenten für die Auswertung der zweiten Pilotprojektphase sowie einer Struktur für den ausführlichen Zwischenbericht
* Erstellung des Berichts zur ersten Projektphase zuhanden der DISG/KOSEG inklusive Zustellung des Konzepts für das Leistungsangebot
Das bringst du mit
Wir suchen eine reflektierte, mutige und verbindende Persönlichkeit, die Freude und Leidenschaft für innovative Pionierarbeit mitbringt. Besonders relevant für diese Aufgabe sind:
* Ausbildung in Sozialer Arbeit, Sozialpädagogik, Heilpädagogik, Psychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, idealerweise im stationären Bereich oder im Pflegekinderwesen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Traumapädagogik, Bindungstheorie und traumasensibler Beziehungsgestaltung
* Erfahrung in Projektleitung, Konzeptentwicklung und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
* Bereitschaft zu einer gleichwertigen Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und Freude an partizipativen Entscheidungs- und Arbeitsformaten
* Sicherheit und Eigenständigkeit im schriftlichen Arbeiten, in der Berichterstattung, im Umgang mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln und im Aufbau fachlicher Grundlagen
* Hohe Selbständigkeit, eine sehr gute Arbeitsorganisation und Freude daran, aus Ideen konkrete nächste Schritte zu entwickeln
* Kommunikationsstärke, Vernetzungsfähigkeit und die Gabe, unterschiedliche Akteurinnen und Akteure konstruktiv einzubinden
Das bieten wir
* Eine sinnstiftende Projektaufgabe mit grosser fachlicher, gesellschaftlicher und menschlicher Relevanz
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und eine hohe fachliche Autonomie beim Aufbau eines neuen kantonalen Pilotangebots
* Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Organisationen und Fachpersonen der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Fachlichen Austausch mit traumapädagogischer Expertise
* Sehr flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Rahmen des Projektauftrags
* Die Möglichkeit, Grundlagen für ein spezialisiertes Angebot mit nachhaltiger Wirkung zu schaffen
* Option auf längerfristige Rolle bei erfolgreicher Pilotphase
Worum es im Angebot geht
Im Zentrum des künftigen Angebots steht eine bewährte Idee aus dem nahen Ausland: Eine sozialpädagogische Fachperson stellt ihr eigenes Zuhause für die längerfristige Betreuung eines Kindes zur Verfügung und wird dafür in einem 100-Prozent-Pensum angestellt.

Sie wird von Menschen aus ihrem persönlichen Umfeld sowie von professionellen Unterstützungspersonen begleitet und entlastet. So entsteht ein tragfähiges Netz rund um das Kind und die betreuende Fachperson. Das Angebot verbindet Kontinuität, verlässliche Beziehungen, Schutz, Partizipation und traumasensible Begleitung.

Kinder und Jugendliche sollen einen äusseren und personalen sicheren Ort erleben, korrigierende Beziehungserfahrungen machen und gemeinsam mit Fachpersonen neue Handlungsroutinen entwickeln können.
Stellenantritt und weiteres Vorgehen
Der Stellenantritt ist per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung vorgesehen.

The Senior Program Manager, Long Haul OSP Deployment is responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of Zayo's long haul fiber deployment portfolio through direct oversight of turnkey engineering and construction partners, cross-functional leadership, and governance of multiple concurrent, large-scale infrastructure programs. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead large-scale material handling and automation projects for some of the world’s most recognized brands, serving as a trusted partner to both customers and internal teams throughout the entire project lifecycle.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast paced, highly collaborative environments and enjoys balancing customer relationships, operational execution, financial ownership, and team leadership. Throughout the interview process, we take the time to understand each candidate’s technical experience, project background, leadership style, and long-term interests so we can thoughtfully align talent to the right team and business need across Parcel and/or Distribution & Fulfillment.

You will be responsible for guiding projects from kickoff through completion while maintaining strong communication, driving accountability, solving problems, and ensuring successful project delivery.
Sound like you? Read on.
In this role, you will…
Coordinate all phases of the project lifecycle including initiation, planning, execution, and closeout.
Develop and maintain detailed project schedules using Microsoft Project, ensuring alignment to scope, priorities, critical path, and resource allocation.
Lead the overall project execution strategy while leveraging DCS lifecycle management processes and procedures to ensure consistency with commitments and goals.
Provide leadership and direction to cross functional teams, creating clarity around responsibilities, accountability, communication, and project expectations.
Partner with internal teams to gather, define, and communicate project requirements across technical and non technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with leadership and cross functional partners to align resources against project demands and proactively address gaps or risks.
Manage day to day customer communication and expectations across large-scale automation and material handling projects.
Drive organizational transparency, accountability, and risk mitigation throughout the project lifecycle.

Identify and resolve project and financial issues as they arise.

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance .
That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination?

To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
What you'll be doing
As our Senior Strategic Project Manager within the Office of the CEO, you will be a primary execution driver behind our most critical cross-functional initiatives. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting executive leadership with operational, regulatory, product, and business teams across our Luxembourg and Milan hubs.
While you will work side-by-side with internal Legal, Compliance, and Risk experts who own the regulatory subject matter, your core strength is senior strategic leadership and project execution: acting as a key leader within the organization to orchestrate complex initiatives across different verticals, driving high-impact project timelines, and turning corporate obligations into seamless operational workflows.

s.h: Here's what that looks like in practice
s.t:
Solve complex business challenges - Tackling intricate business problems by developing innovative, data-backed solutions with a consistent user-first approach.
Stakeholder management and strategic partnership - Managing relationships with C-level stakeholders and acting as a thought partner for leadership on specific strategic areas.
Strategic influence - Influencing major decisions through in-depth analysis and proven insights, integrating diverse perspectives into coherent strategies.
Champion methodology and best practices - Developing and introducing new methodologies, best practices, or frameworks within the team or company, ensuring a consistent user-first approach.
Champion Regulatory Requirements in Roadmap Design - Act as the project manager champion for what regulatory and supervisory requirements apply to a given initiative, ensuring they are proactively factored into project roadmaps at the design stage - partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk.
Govern & Monitor Multi-Hub Projects - Establish project governance, track milestones across offices, proactively remove cross-departmental bottlenecks, mitigate delivery risks, and provide crisp, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.
Anchor Luxembourg Operational Synergies - Serve as an authoritative on-the-ground project leader in Luxembourg, ensuring that financial institution governance requirements seamlessly harmonize with Satispay’s group-wide strategy and product velocity.

This role needs someone who is a problem-solver that loves teamwork, gets things done, and is ready for real ownership across regulated financial environments.
Experience - Minimum 6–7 years of hands-on experience within a regulated environment -ideally within high-growth Fintech, Scale-ups, EMI/Banking institutions, or Financial Services.
Regulatory Expertise - Hands-on knowledge and deep familiarity with compliance, legal, and regulatory matters.
Master Project Operator - Proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end multi-stakeholder initiatives using structured project management frameworks.
Fintech & EMI Licensing Awareness - Good high-level familiarity with the fintech landscape, EMI/payment institution dynamics, and European financial regulation concepts (PSD2/PSD3, AML/CFT, GDPR) — enough to translate requirements into project delivery without needing to be the legal specialist yourself.
Cross-Border Leadership - Demonstrated ability to build consensus, establish momentum, and align priorities across distributed international offices and matrixed teams.
Executive Presence - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to synthesize technical, operational, and regulatory concepts into clear, executive-level narratives and actionable plans.
Mobility - Based in Luxembourg with a willingness for frequent, hands-on collaboration travel to our Milan headquarters.
Languages - Fluent in English (written and spoken). Italian is a strong asset.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

s.h: CareAbout: how we support your impact
s.t: We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

We operate like an internal think tank: developing clear views of desirable long-range outcomes, examining the choices that could make those outcomes more likely, and producing ideas that help OpenAI and the broader public navigate profound technological change.
The team is intentionally lean and highly collaborative. Our work draws from public policy, law, economics, political science, history, institutional design, technology, and other relevant disciplines. We partner closely with experts across OpenAI to connect long-range thinking with evolving AI capabilities, organizational priorities, and real-world policy questions.

We are looking for a highly organized and strategic operator to serve as Chief of Staff and Program Manager for the Strategic Futures team.
Working closely with the team’s leader, you will translate broad priorities into coordinated execution, establish the systems and operating rhythms that keep a small team performing at a high level, and ensure important work moves forward with clarity and consistency.
This is a hands-on role combining chief-of-staff partnership, program management, strategic planning, cross-functional coordination, and communications. You will make it easier for the team to focus on high-quality research and writing by ensuring priorities are clear, decisions are documented, dependencies are visible, collaborators are engaged, and follow-through is reliable.
You will also serve as a central connector between Strategic Futures and teams across OpenAI, helping the group build trusted relationships, navigate organizational complexity, and contribute effectively to broader company priorities. As such, this role is based in San Francisco.

Partner closely with the leader of Strategic Futures to translate the team’s strategic direction into clear priorities, operating plans, and concrete deliverables.
Own team-wide planning and execution across research projects, publications, cross-functional collaborations, public-facing work, and special initiatives.
Convert open-ended goals into structured workplans with clear outcomes, owners, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and decision points.
Develop and maintain lightweight operating systems, including team roadmaps, project trackers, meeting cadences, decision logs, risk registers, and publication or launch plans.
Establish operating rhythms that give the team appropriate visibility and accountability without creating unnecessary process.
Coordinate work across Global Affairs, Legal, Research, product policy, safety, preparedness, Communications, and other relevant teams.
Build productive relationships with internal partners and help ensure Strategic Futures has a clear and consistent presence across the organization.
Prepare executive-ready briefings, strategic updates, presentations, agendas, decision documents, talking points, and other written materials.
Plan and run effective team and cross-functional meetings, ensuring participants are prepared, decisions are captured, and action items are completed.
Anticipate potential bottlenecks, gaps, and competing priorities, and proactively develop solutions that keep work moving.
Maintain visibility across the team’s portfolio and help the team leader make informed prioritization and resource-allocation decisions.
Coordinate internal review and approval processes for research, publications, presentations, and other public-facing work.
Support external engagements, convenings, and public communication when appropriate.
Develop AI-enabled workflows that improve project management, knowledge sharing, information synthesis, coordination, and team effectiveness.
Help define and evolve the team’s operating model, norms, and ways of working as Strategic Futures grows.

The Correspondence Program Manager: Manages the operation of the Executive Correspondence office and manages the Exec Sec Staff including correspondence assistants and clerical personnel of the unit. Assures the proper coordination of actions within and outside NHTSA about correspondence.

Reviews documents, papers, Reports to Congress, and other communications submitted to the Office of the Administrator to assure completed staff work, including adequate coordination, cooperative operations, and activities.

Assists professional staff inquiries concerning preferred style and correspondence practices, clearance, distribution and usage techniques and establishes guidelines and standards for controversial approaches and viewpoints. Supervises the application of the Executive Correspondence system.

Assures that effective means are provided to achieve clerical and technical accuracy, completeness and correct format in papers submitted by the program for information, consideration, approval, and/or signature of the Administrator or for the Secretary.

The ideal candidate for this position possesses excellent organizational skills and is capable of garnering support throughout the organization to accomplish the agency's mission.

NHTSA is looking for someone who is highly motivated, who can facilitate processes, and who can communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, at all levels of the organization. As a manager, the ideal candidate must be able to motivate, train and recognize employees and deliver results through their performance.

The ideal candidate possesses a keen understanding of organizational dynamics and the ability to prioritize a large volume of urgent, high-priority tasks.

The director of the office of Executive Correspondence must possess strong interpersonal skills and the ability to track multiple diverse priorities acknowledging competing pressures while still engaging senior executives to meet tight deadlines.

The ideal candidate must possess a knowledge of federal government correspondence, civilian or Military protocols and be technically adept at managing the Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) system.
To meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet the specialized experience requirements. Experience in managing and leading a correspondence team to deliver exceptional customer service in a timely manner within fast-paced environment.

Experience in presenting sensitive recommendations and briefings to senior leadership both in writing and through high-level presentations that embody a customer service-orientated posture and utilize interpersonal skills.

Technical Project Manager – In-person Payments Software Release
In-person payments at Adyen go beyond payments made in stores on traditional terminals. We also power shopper experiences on small card readers and on phones. This part of our business is growing fast, and we're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own and improve the software release process.
The IPP Integrity team improves how Adyen's In-Person Payments products are tested, released, certified and monitored, to raise their quality, predictability and reliability. We work with other internal teams to make these processes more data-driven, streamlined and automated. Our goal is to help Adyen's engineering teams build and verify their products on their own, quickly and at massive scale.

Plan and organize the software release schedule and coordinate the release with the engineering teams.
Lead and complete various strategic internal projects related to improving our release management, testing, monitoring and incident management processes.
Collaborate with external and internal , technical and non-technical teams to make your projects a success.
Define overarching metrics for the performance of our release quality, monitoring and testing tools.
Proactively improve or create processes to improve the reliability, quality, or execution speed of our firmware releases.

You have 3+ years experience in project management within a technical environment.
A big plus are experience in topics including: Reliability, Release Management, DevOps, Testing, Monitoring and/or Incident Management.
You have a good understanding of the software development process from planning to release and monitoring.
Previous knowledge related to the payments industry or payment terminals is not required, but is a strong plus.
You enjoy working independently and autonomously in your day-to-day.
You work best under uncertainty and enjoy scoping full projects and processes.

At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.
In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.
We’re looking for someone who combines the mindset of a consultant, the discipline of a strong program leader and operator, and a genuine passion for creating a great employee experience.
This role is for someone who is naturally curious about how things work—and how they could work better. You’ll look across employee feedback, processes, systems, and stakeholder experiences to identify friction, diagnose root causes, and design thoughtful, scalable solutions.
Initially, you’ll focus on three critical areas of the employee lifecycle: onboarding, employee listening, and engagement. You’ll partner closely with teams across People, Talent Acquisition, IT, Workplace, and the business to understand needs, bring structure to complex or ambiguous problems, and improve the experiences employees and managers have at Algolia.
You won’t just execute existing processes. You’ll help shape the strategy behind them, lead programs from discovery through implementation, and continuously ask: What problem are we trying to solve? What are employees actually experiencing? Where is friction showing up? What does the data tell us? And how can we create something that works better for both employees and the business?
Success in this role means creating employee experiences that feel thoughtful, human, and connected while building the structure, processes, and operating discipline needed to make those experiences scalable and sustainable.

Employee Listening & Insights
Own the execution and evolution of Algolia’s employee listening strategy, including engagement, pulse, onboarding, exit, and other lifecycle surveys.
Turn employee feedback into meaningful insights by identifying trends, themes, risks, and opportunities.
Combine quantitative data with qualitative feedback to understand what is happening and why.
Develop clear narratives and recommendations that help leaders move from data to action.
Partner with leaders and People Business Partners to understand what sits behind the data and determine where deeper discovery may be needed.
Create reporting, communications, action-planning resources, and follow-up mechanisms that make employee feedback useful—not simply informational.
Establish thoughtful processes that create a consistent and scalable approach to employee listening.
Evaluate the effectiveness of listening programs and continuously improve how we collect, interpret, and act on feedback.
Onboarding Experience
Own and continuously improve the end-to-end onboarding experience, from pre-boarding through the first 90 days.
Assess the new hire journey across systems, communications, learning, manager touchpoints, community, and workplace experiences to identify friction and opportunities.
Partner across Talent Acquisition, People Operations, IT, Workplace, Learning & Development, and business teams to create a coordinated experience.
Use onboarding feedback, operational metrics, stakeholder input, and employee insights to prioritize improvements.
Design experiences that help new hires build clarity, connection, confidence, and productivity more quickly.
Establish clear ownership and workflows across the many teams involved in onboarding.
Identify opportunities to simplify and automate onboarding processes without losing the human moments that matter.
Design Better Processes and Experiences
Evaluate existing employee experience processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, redesign, or automate them.
Conduct discovery with employees, managers, and stakeholders to understand needs, pain points, and lived experiences before designing solutions.
Build clear, scalable workflows with defined ownership, decision points, handoffs, documentation, and measures of success.
Balance employee needs, business requirements, and operational realities when designing solutions.
Translate strategy into practical execution plans while maintaining a strong focus on the employee experience.
Build feedback loops into programs so employee and stakeholder input continuously informs how experiences evolve.
Establish mechanisms for continuously evaluating whether programs and processes are delivering the intended experience.

A deeply employee-centered mindset, with strong empathy, active listening skills, and curiosity about how processes, systems, communications, and decisions are experienced by employees.
A process-oriented mindset with experience designing, improving, and operationalizing workflows and programs.
Strong program and project management skills, including the ability to define scope, prioritize work, manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder accountability.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take an ambiguous challenge, diagnose root causes, and create a structured path forward.
Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to combine quantitative data with qualitative insights to identify patterns and make recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear insights, recommendations, and decisions.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including the ability to build trust, navigate competing perspectives, and influence without authority.
A continuous improvement mindset and curiosity about how technology, AI, and automation can make work both more efficient and more human.
Comfort operating in environments where the answer or process may not yet exist.

Experience in creating people strategy and an eagerness to improve employee engagement, connection & belonging
Experience with employee listening, onboarding, engagement, or lifecycle programs.
Experience leading initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, perspectives and priorities
Experience with Lattice, Seismic, or similar tools
Experience supporting global or distributed organizations
Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools and workflow automation
What Success Looks Like

s.h: Within your first year, you will
s.t:
Become a trusted thought partner who helps the People team diagnose employee experience challenges and turn them into practical solutions.
Deliver employee experience programs with strong project discipline, clear ownership, effective stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
Build a more consistent, intentional, and measurable onboarding experience that improves new hire clarity, connection, readiness, and engagement.
Establish an employee listening approach that moves beyond reporting results to generating insights and driving meaningful action.

Work through emerging or ambiguous questions, test assumptions, identify gaps or conflicting evidence, and help determine what additional analysis or decisions are needed.

Partner with governance-body chairs, technical leaders, and other stakeholders to shape substantive reviews, frame the questions that matter, and communicate conclusions clearly.
Translate feedback, recommendations, and decisions into concrete work with accountable owners, milestones, dependencies, and clear criteria for completion.
Drive that work forward across teams, resolve blockers, surface difficult tradeoffs, and escalate disagreements or resource gaps when needed.
Help teams understand which governance processes apply, integrate reviews into research and deployment plans, and identify changes that require further consideration.
Maintain clear records of decisions, rationale, conditions, commitments, exceptions, and unresolved questions.
Help improve governance practices, standards, and guidance as capabilities, evidence, and circumstances evolve.
Build and refine practical tools, operating cadences, and sources of truth that improve the quality and pace of the work.
Develop trusted relationships across Research, Safety Systems, Preparedness, Security, Legal, Product, leadership, and relevant external partners.

Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.
Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S.

Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.
Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.
You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.

When a lab signs with CrelioHealth , you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.
This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location — and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.

Lead onboarding projects for new US clients — single-site labs through multi-location networks — from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.
Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.
Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go-live on schedule.
Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training — roughly 25–40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.
Make clients successful
Train lab staff on real workflows — accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal — and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.
Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.
Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.
Champion the platform
Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently — to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.
Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team — with incentives for you when they close.
Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

4–7 years of project management experience , with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.
Healthcare experience is required ; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred — as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).
Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.
Excellent presenter and communicator — comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.
Structured and self-managing: you can run multiple concurrent onboardings remotely without anyone chasing you.
Willingness to travel to client sites across the US; valid driver’s license and authorization to work in the United States.
Nice-to-haves
Direct experience with an LIS/LIMS migration or go-live (any vendor).
Familiarity with HL7v2 / FHIR interfaces, lab billing/RCM basics, or instrument middleware.
Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or pre-sales — anywhere you have had to win people over, not just manage tasks.
PMP, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma is welcome but not required — we care more about go-lives you have shipped than certificates you hold.
Comfort using modern AI tools to work faster (drafting plans, summarizing calls, preparing training material) — with the judgment to know what still needs a human.
How We Hire
We know polished resumes and cover letters are easy to generate these days, so our process is built around watching you work rather than reading about it. After a screening call, you will do a live onboarding simulation based on a realistic lab scenario, and a short role-play where you present CrelioHealth to a (friendly but skeptical) “lab director.” No trick questions, no take-home busywork — just the actual job, compressed. We will respect your time and give you a decision quickly.

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time.
