Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
As Senior Program Manager, R&D Talent Programs, you will own the Product/Design talent program end to end—strategy, structure, cohort experience, and stakeholder alignment—serving as the primary point of contact and the planner who builds the cohorts that become the next generation of Toast's Product and Design leadership.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Early Careers team, who manages university partnerships and the talent pipeline, as well as the Recruitment team, who oversees candidate sourcing and requisition management.
Our Product internship program is where you'll start. As that program matures, you will design and build the talent programs that come next—extending to Design and the wider set of programs that develop talent across R&D. This is a role with room to define its own scope over time.
This role is ideal for someone who has built a talent program. You will set strategy alongside Product & Design leadership, then do the work that makes strategy real: securing headcount, establishing timelines, designing an evaluation bar, and creating an intern experience good enough that the best candidates say yes. You will work in close partnership with People Success Partners, Early Careers, Recruitment, Finance, Compensation, and Product/Design leadership.
This role sits within the R&D Operations team at Toast - we are on a mission to empower our teams to build great products efficiently, effectively, and at scale. We remove obstacles, foster alignment, and help teams focus on what matters most—solving real problems for our customers. We also play a central role in building the talent pipeline for the future.

Own the Product and Design program side of our internship and early-career programs —program design, structure, timeline, deliverables, communications, and intern experience once candidates are in the pipeline (sourcing, screening, and requisition-to-offer recruiting mechanics sit with Early Careers and Recruitment). Build a structure for managers to determine internship projects and team placements.
Size and secure intern headcount each cycle, and partner with Early Careers/Recruitment to ensure hiring plans, timelines, and evaluation criteria set them up for success.
Build world-class programming - including onboarding, an executive speaker series, intern showcase and capstone presentations, and cohort culture and community.
Design the conversion process, including the evaluation frameworks, compensation packages, and “sell” experience.
Keep stakeholders aligned and informed, from intern managers to leaders, on program direction, level, budget, and placement.
Represent Product at university partner engagements and campus events set up by Early Careers. Partner with Recruitment to source market intelligence to keep our process and our offers competitive.
Run end-of-cycle retrospectives and translate them into the following year's plan, growing this from a single-cohort program into a durable, multi-function leadership pipeline for Toast.
Design and build new talent programs over time—identifying where R&D's biggest talent gaps are, making the case for a program to address them, and standing it up from a blank page.
Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build.

7+ years of relevant experience across talent programs, early career or university recruiting, program management, or R&D/Product Operations.
A track record of building and growing a talent program—you have stood something up and scaled it.
University, MBA, or early-career recruiting experience strongly preferred, including familiarity with campus recruiting calendars and competitive dynamics.
Exceptional program management: you can hold many parallel workstreams, stakeholders, and hard external deadlines without dropping any of them.
Proven ability to influence without authority—briefing executives, holding senior managers to commitments, and absorbing pushback while keeping the program on track.
Sound judgment on talent, with the ability to build and steward an evaluation bar and calibrate fairly across dissimilar work.
Outstanding written and verbal communication; you distill complexity into clarity for audiences from interns to the executive team.
Genuine energy for early-career talent. For many candidates, you are their first and most lasting impression of Toast.
Based in Boston and able to be onsite regularly, since the cohort experience and campus engagements happen in person.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
ServiceNow’s APEX (AI, Product, Engineering, and Experience) org is the largest organization in the company, comprised of all Products and Platform teams, along with our world class Design teams.

We are leveraging the unlimited potential of our platform across every industry, geography, solutions, and personas to consistently deliver product and platform experiences our customers love.

APEX is where ServiceNow's most critical innovations are conceived, built, and scaled — and where the programs you lead directly shape the trajectory of the company.
We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to join our APEX Strategic Programs organization. In this role, you will drive ServiceNow's most critical cross-functional priorities and strategic programs— operating at the intersection of strategy and execution and setting the standard for how high-impact programs are designed, governed, and run at scale.
This person will operate as an AI-native leader, using AI tools to accelerate program delivery, synthesize intelligence across workstreams and model the ways of working we expect to scale across APEX. In addition, the candidate is a result-oriented self-starter with extensive competence and experience in the Technical Program Management space.

This candidate thinks strategically but loves getting into the details and possesses a strong ability to conceptualize, develop, drive, coordinate and manage large, complex, cross-functional programs supporting formal company Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

This person is effective at building relationships, collaborating, and influencing others; they must also be highly experienced working with senior executives across various geographies and functions.

Drives large-scale, high-visibility cross-functional programs for the APEX Strategic Programs function: Identify, prioritize, and accelerate programs of the highest complexity with quantifiable impact on revenue, market position, and competitive advantage
Translate business objectives into execution strategy, both tactical and strategic, and take full ownership of project planning and delivery for cross-organizational programs from initial conception through transition to operations
Organize complex, ambiguous problems into prioritized milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and success criteria — designing programs to deliver specific strategic outcomes and drive relentless accountability against them
Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders, technology, and functional leaders to drive focus on the strategic program objectives and optimize program delivery. This includes establishing regular cadences and holding resources accountable for their responsibilities within the program
Develop and implement scalable processes, templates, and training to ensure program delivery and process adoption; oversee change management efforts, guiding teams through organizational transitions and improvements
Operate as an AI-native program manager — using AI to synthesize intelligence across workstreams, surface risk signals, ensure data informs decision-making, draft and tailor communications at speed, direct AI agents, and provide leadership with actionable, forward-looking intelligence
Establish governance frameworks and lead executive-level meetings and cross-functional events; serve as the go-to source of leadership, transparency, and visibility — clearly communicating objectives, status, risks, and results while ensuring surgical execution and handoffs across workstreams
Champion AI-native ways of working across the APEX Strategic Programs team — evaluating, adopting, and scaling AI tools that increase team throughput, reduce coordination overhead, and surface insights faster across complex program portfolios
12-15+ years of experience driving large-scale, complex global change initiatives and programs to successful implementation: preferably in Technical Program Management, Strategic Program Management, Mergers and Acquisition Integrations, Management Consulting, or Strategy roles high-stakes environments
Program leadership track record : You've successfully led large, complex cross-functional programs to completion—whether in TPM, strategy consulting, M&A integration, or similar roles. You know how to navigate ambiguity and drive accountability at scale.
nyone in between.
AI-native mindset : You're curious about how AI can actually improve how you work—not just talk about it. You experiment with AI tools, iterate on outputs, and think critically about where they're genuinely useful versus hype.
SaaS/enterprise software context : You understand how the space works—the constraints, the competitive dynamics, what customers care about. You've worked in or closely with this industry
Strategic + execution mindset : You think ahead but don't get lost in strategy—you're equally comfortable owning the details and unblocking people to get work done. You can translate big goals into concrete milestones without losing sight of the outcome.
Stakeholder navigation : You build trust with senior leaders and technical teams quickly. You influence without authority, bring people together across functions and levels, and keep them focused on what actually matters.
Clear communication : You write and speak clearly about complex topics. You're good at distilling noise into signal and can explain why something matters to an executive, an engineer, or anyone in between.
Self-directed : You don't need a lot of hand-holding. You move independently, stay organized, and keep things moving when things get messy.

s.t:
Projektleiter/in Partner\- und Produktmanagement

* **Partnermanagement / Regionen\-Manager/in:** Du führst das Regionenbudget der Partnergemeinden(Ennetbürgen, Buochs, Beckenried, Emmetten, Seelisberg, Isenthal) und bist das zentrale Gesichtsowie die Vertrauensperson für die lokalen Tourismusorganisationen (LTOs) und Leistungsträger.

* Kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit überzeugendem und argumentationsstarkem Auftreten
* Kenntnisse der Region oder die Begeisterung, dich darin zu verwurzeln
* Eine sehr hohe Eigenverantwortung, ausgeprägte Kreativität, lösungsorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit,dich in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld sicher zu bewegen, bilden die Grundlage.
### Wir bieten
* Eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit
* Ein zukunftsorientiertes und agiles Organisationsmodell mit flachen Hierarchien
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten Tourismusakteuren in der Region
* Einen zentral gelegenen Arbeitsort in Stans im Herzen von Nidwalden

Wir sorgen dafür, dass Temperatur und Klima stimmen – für Mensch und Natur. Als unabhängiges, familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit über 300 Mitarbeitenden setzen wir uns seit 1981 für erneuerbare Energien und energetisch sinnvolle Systemlösungen ein, die Gebäude zuverlässig kühlen oder heizen.

Mit unseren Wärmepumpen, Klimageräten und Kältemaschinen leisten wir täglich einen konkreten Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft – unterstützt durch einen Service, der langfristig begleitet. Dabei zählen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitgestalten, mutig entscheiden und den Unterschied machen.

Persönlich, ehrlich und echt – dafür steht CTA.

Planerberater\*in Wärmepumpen, Region Mitte (BE, AG, SO, BL, BS)
Ihr Wirkungsfeld
* Aufbau und Pflege eines aktiven Netzwerks zu Planungsbüros, Ingenieuren, Architekt\*innen sowie weiteren Projektbeeinflussenden
* Akquisition und Begleitung von Projekten in der Vorprojekt\- und Planungsphase
* Submissionspipeline aktiv aufbauen und pflegen
* Technische Beratung bei der Auslegung und Konzeption von Wärmepumpen\- und Systemlösungen
* Unterstützung bei Ausschreibungen, Vorstudien, Variantenvergleichen und Konzeptentwicklungen
* Platzierung von CTA\-Lösungen in Leistungsverzeichnissen und Ausschreibungen
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Verkauf, Technik und Produktmanagement zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss
Ihr Rucksack
* Technische Grundausbildung in der Gebäudetechnik
* Weiterbildung im Bereich Heizung, Energie oder Gebäudetechnik von Vorteil
* Erfahrung in der Planung, Projektierung oder technischen Beratung von Gebäudetechniksystemen
* Gute Kenntnisse von Wärmepumpen\-, Heizungs\- oder Energiesystemen
* Vernetzte Denkweise sowie eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
* Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

Ihre Perspektive
